title: Semi-automated newsroom trial: trend stories you steer (Anth.us first)
description: Make the steer-your-newsroom loop work end to end and prove it on Anth.us: trend Proposed Stories from several References with Anthus-side evidence, a Humanus gate at filing, accept creates the story, copy-edit gate, configurable publish gate (required on Anth.us), editor decisions train the pipeline. Plan: consultant report 2026-10-31. Doubles as product demo and p.apyr.us material.
